title: Document how the goals were selected and mapped to components
requirements:
- Describe participants, evidence, steps and validation
- Summarise the mapping method, sources, participants, review criteria and handling of disagreement
- Summarise the selection method, evidence and consultation
- Note that countries and regional bodies may already have agreed goal frameworks and explain how the seven goals relate to them
- Explain how component-led bias was controlled
- Distinguish architectural judgement from empirical evidence, with references or an evidence register for material mapping decisions
- Explain why leadership and governance is treated as a principle rather than a goal
- Separate generic capabilities from technologies
